 Live .  12,867 viewing 12867 viewing Pakistan captain Shaheen takes third wicket to leave England 145-5
 Sun 25 Oct 2026 , Men's One Day International Series Pakistan vs England (batting), in play Pakistan Pakistan In Play England England Yet to bat 169 -5 ( 31.3 ) England are 169 for 5 with 18.3 overs remaining Pakistan: yet to bat England innings: 169 for 5 from 31.3 overs, in play
 Live Reporting (active) 
 Scorecard 
 Summary
 ODI tri-series, Lahore
 Pakistan win toss and bowl
 Duckett hits fifty to steady England after poor start
 Pakistan captain Shaheen takes three wickets, Brook run out and Rauf dismisses Cox
 Crocombe makes England debut
 Listen to live BBC Radio 5 Sports Extra commentary by clicking tab at top of page
 Close form Have your say on England men this winter
 Get involved Live Reporting
 by Mike Peter
 get involved Get Involved published at 10:32 GMT 10:32 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 Feel like we are a batter short. We have lots of all-rounders but Jordan Cox at five and Sam Curran at six feels a position too high. Pressure on the top four to get the runs. When they don't it is a long tail.
 Gerrard, Cannock 
 0 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Eng 165-5 published at 31 overs 31 overs 
 Ben Duckett and Will Jacks work Arafat Minhas for six steady runs off the over.
 The pair not going for the big shot yet against the spinner who tore through them on Tuesday.
 0 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 10:28 GMT 10:28 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 Did we read the script that they have 50 overs to bat?
Doesn't that mean, no more than four wickets down in the first 35 overs and no more than 8 overall? Anything worse than that loses the game.
 Michael, Worcester 
 5 38 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Eng 159-5 published at 30 overs 30 overs 
 Haris Rauf sends down a leg-side delivery with the first ball after drinks and Ben Duckett helps it on its way for four.
 That takes Duckett into the nineties.
 15 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 10:23 GMT 10:23 GMT 
 Alex Hartley 
Former England bowler on Test Match Special 
 Image source, Reuters Pakistan will be happy with the state of play at this stage of the game. England five down, losing Tom Banton, Harry Brook and Joe Root early in the innings. Now Ben Duckett and Will Jacks have to build another partnership.
 25 11 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 drinks break Eng 151-5 published at 29 overs 29 overs 
 Arafat Minhas, who took 6-40 against England in Rawalpindi, finally enters the attack.
 Ben Duckett, who doesn't fare especially well against left-arm spinners in ODIs, faces five dot balls then takes a single off the final ball of the over.
 The players will take drinks.
 8 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 How stat?! published at 10:18 GMT 10:18 GMT 
 Pakistan's quicks have persisted with the short ball during this middle phase and have finally been rewarded with the wicket of Sam Curran. 
 Prior to Curran's dismissal England had scored boundaries off six of the 13 genuine bouncers bowled.
 15 6 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 10:17 GMT 10:17 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 Image source, Reuters Stupid, stupid, stupid. Sam Curran, why are you taking on the short ball there? We were in such a good position.
 Ben, Reading 
 88 38 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Eng 150-5 published at 28 overs 28 overs 
 A run from each of the next five balls.
 Another Ben Duckett sweep down to fine leg brings up England's 150.
 24 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 10:15 GMT 10:15 GMT 
 Jonathan Agnew 
BBC Chief Cricket Commentator on Test Match Special 
 The graphics make it miss like a country mile, but it was only a couple of inches. 
 15 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Not out published at 27.1 overs 27.1 overs 
 Eng 145-5 
 No, passing leg stump.
 Shadab Khan was bowling from around the wicket, so it was always going to be a challenge to get the angle right.
 Pakistan lose a review.
 31 9 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Pakistan review published at 10:14 GMT 10:14 GMT 
 Now, have Pakistan got the key wicket of Ben Duckett?
 Nothing from the umpire after the England opener is struck on the pad trying to turn Shadab Khan behind square.
 Shadab is convinced, Saad Baig behind the stumps isn't interested, Shaheen decides to go for the review.
 5 16 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Eng 145-5 published at 27 overs 27 overs 
 Ooof, not so far away.
 Will Jacks hangs his bat in the channel and Shaheen Shah Afridi's delivery flies past the outside edge.
 5 10 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 10:10 GMT 10:10 GMT 
 Alex Hartley 
Former England bowler on Test Match Special 
 The trap was set. Sam Curran hooks in the air, and that's exactly what he has done. 
 It flew down to the fine leg fielder. Disappointing for England. 
 13 58 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 10:08 GMT 10:08 GMT 
 Jonathan Agnew 
BBC Chief Cricket Commentator on Test Match Special 
 Sam Curran hooks it in the air and he has picked out the man. It was quite a good catch. 
 13 42 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 WICKET published at 26.4 overs 26.4 overs 
 Curran c Agha b Shaheen 42 (Eng 145-5) 
 Image source, Getty Images It won't be a hundred partnership!
 Sam Curran takes on Shaheen Shah Afridi's short ball and does really get hold of it, pulling the ball to Salman Agha coming off the ropes at fine leg.
 Here comes Will Jacks.
 32 144 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 10:08 GMT 10:08 GMT 
 Alex Hartley 
Former England bowler on Test Match Special 
 The partnership is well and truly needed. Sam Curran and Ben Duckett are both showing their experience on the international stage. 
 14 27 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 10:08 GMT 10:08 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 Image source, Reuters Reading the comments, the expectation is that England will win every game, never lose wickets unless it’s the ball of the century and they should bowl the opposition out for under 50. People have forgotten how fine the margins are and the difficulty of the game.
 Matthew, Woodstock 
 167 20 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Eng 143-4 published at 26 overs 26 overs 
 Thanks Tim.
 I do like an early Sunday run, but the shift time and the stormy weather conditions rather precluded it this morning.
 Much as it's good to get out, I didn't fancy a sudden gust of wind embedding a road sign in my chest.
 Over in Lahore, Ben Duckett drives Shadab Khan through the covers for four - this partnership now worth 91 at the end of the over
 28 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 10:01 GMT 10:01 GMT 
 Timothy Abraham 
BBC Sport journalist 
 Pakistan in pink today. 
 Doubtless a similar shade to the rosy cherubic cheeks of Mike Peter after his run on a blustery Autumn morning earlier? 
 Anyway, Mike's on hand to talk you through the rest of England's innings in Lahore.
